## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)

## Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the project's formatting standards (`gofmt -l .` outputs nothing).
- [ ] I have executed the full test suite locally with the race detector (`go test -race ./...`).
- [ ] All tests pass cleanly with 0 failures and 0 warnings (`go vet ./...`).
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation / README / CHANGELOG if public APIs or behaviors changed.
- [ ] Zero secrets, private tokens, or debug print statements were left behind.
